worktreeRoot.description: Where issue worktrees go: absolute, ~/..., or relative to the repo root (default ../<repo>-worktrees).

parent.description: Tracking issue; follow-up issues become its sub-issues.

defaultLenses.description: Lenses every run gets; must include "code" (default ["code"]).

design.description: Where the project's design lives and how to treat it, for every stage. E.g. 'The design record is README.md plus the ADRs in docs/adr/; a change that contradicts an ADR must say so in its spec.'

seamNote.description: What later issues build on, for the `seam` label's reviewer note. E.g. 'the export query, the page templates'.

design.description: What the spec's Design section must pin down for this project (files, interfaces, schemas, routes, fixtures...).

implement.description: Project rules for the implement stage: fixtures, data that tests must never read, how to run things.

command.description: Shell command, run with sh from the worktree root. Integration runs it on the host exactly as written, granted only when /crucible read the config from origin/main.

checks.description: Commands every writing stage runs and reports, by name; after merging main, integration runs all of them as host commands. Empty: the run reports "no checks configured".

lenses.description: Review lenses by name. `code` must be defined; label `review:<name>` adds a lens to a run.

name.description: No control characters, backticks, $ or backslashes.

commitAuthor.description: Commit identity for the stages (default: the worktree's git config).

fast.description: Implement, revise, the integration fix, PR (default claude-bridge/claude-sonnet-5-5).

small.description: Flagging a human and the integration merge (default claude-bridge/claude-haiku-5-5).
